title: Magician: Master
author: Feist, Raymond E.
review: 3.75/5 a step up from book 1. Some events happen too abruptly but very enjoyable classic fantasy. Can't say that I care too much about the politics in the series but definitely has some cool world building and magic. Definitely a bit messy at times but enjoyable.
